description: Bring an attached Schema's segment & node TYPES (with icons) into the Add Segment / Add Node drawing dropdowns.
instructions: Reads an attached Schema's segment `type` (role seg-type) and node `type` (role node-type) discriminators — their options + per-option icons — and surfaces them to the host so they appear as tools in the Add Segment / Add Node drawing dropdowns (augmenting and overriding the built-ins by value). Wire a Schema into the Schema input. No geometry output.
